'''December 2001 Wenatchee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wenatchee, Washington on 1 December 2001. Ian won it. It is known from Dennis Jeffris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3142">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-wenatchee-washington-12-1-01d3142/ wenatchee-washington-12-1-01], DeckTech (Dennis "PCGSAlucard" Jeffris, 4 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-wenatchee-washington-12-1-01d3142/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Wenatchee, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' Ian
